description: Canonical Indian traffic-sign catalogue. Recognition catalogue only; not a claim that every sign is officially standardised. Each entry records verification status honestly.

standards_reference.primary: MoRTH / IRC:67-2012 Code of Practice for Road Signs (3rd revision) - three categories: Mandatory/Regulatory, Cautionary/Warning, Informatory
standards_reference.status: Category-level reference. Per-entry verification_status must still be checked against the official IRC:67-2012 sign plates before operational use.
standards_reference.speed_limits_note: Indian speed-limit signage includes 20/30/40/50/60/70/80 km/h on urban roads and higher limits on expressways. Not every limit is used in every jurisdiction; classes here exist only because a trained model already has them, or as catalogue proposals.
